{{Quote|A paramilitary force that provides the muscle needed to ensure other divisions of the ISB have the means to carry out their directives.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] describes the Enforcement branch, ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Enforcement''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. It was responsible for providing specialized enforcers and muscle to assist in the Bureau's operations. Usually, Enforcement personnel were seconded to the [[Investigations/Legends|Investigations]] branch, but they occasionally worked with [[Internal Affairs/Legends|Internal Affairs]]. Unlike other branches within the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]], Enforcement hired outside beings who were not members of the Commission, or even loyal to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. This move prompted a keen interest from Internal Affairs, as they believed that using such unindoctrinated personnel was a security risk. However, the policy had positive side effects; it increased the talent pool from which Enforcement was able to draw its operatives, and well as allowing operatives with no COMPNOR ties to conduct missions that could not be linked to the Commission.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> It also oversaw bounties offered by the Imperial military and intelligence forces and made sure they were conducted with discretion.<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
